title: Connie Gomper and the Pack
overview: Connie Gomper and the Pack is a 1996 sports comedy short film that serves as an affectionate, over-the-top lampoon of the famously dedicated fans of the Green Bay Packers. Originally produced as a 20-minute segment for the nationally syndicated television program NFL Films Presents, the feature became so highly requested by viewers that it was later released as a standalone home video.
